summary: Hardcoded API credentials (API_KEY and API_SECRET) are embedded directly in the PaymentGateway class as string constants. These secrets will be committed to version control, exposing them to anyone with repository access. Additionally, a webhook signing secret (whsec_*) appears alongside the API key, which should never be exposed client-side.

items.description: Hardcoded API_KEY and API_SECRET in source code. Move these to environment variables (e.g., ENV['PAYMENT_API_KEY']) or a secure credential store. Rotate the exposed keys immediately.
A webhook signing secret (whsec_*) is hardcoded — this should never be in client-side code. Webhook secrets must remain server-side only and never be shipped in source.
